rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for increasing an amount, degree, or number.

example.english: The workload will multiply if we take on more clients.
example.traditional: 如果再接多啲客，工作量就會增加。
example.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 zoi3 zip3 do1 di1 haak3 gung1 zok3 loeng6 zau6 wui5 zang1 gaa1

rows.note: Use this specifically for performing multiplication in mathematics.

example.english: To multiply three by four gives twelve.
example.jyutping: saam1 sing4 sei3 dang2 jyu1 sap6 ji6

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that a number or group is progressively growing rather than simply increasing.

example.english: The number of people joining the running club continues to multiply.
example.traditional: 而家參加跑步班嘅人越嚟越多。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 caam1 gaa1 paau2 bou6 baan1 ge3 jan4 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 do1
